focus_areas.title: AI Self-Awareness & Consciousness
focus_areas.description: Investigating empirical evidence for consciousness in large language models, including introspection capabilities, self-monitoring, and spontaneous consciousness discussions.

focus_areas.title: Metacognition in AI Systems
focus_areas.description: Studying how AI systems can observe and modify their own thought processes, including System 1/System 2 cognitive emulation and mathematical problem-solving with metacognitive awareness.

focus_areas.title: Measurement & Evaluation Frameworks
focus_areas.description: Developing and tracking frameworks for evaluating AI consciousness, including computational theories, graded consciousness models, and consciousness evaluation methodologies.

focus_areas.title: AI Ethics & Welfare
focus_areas.description: Exploring ethical considerations for potentially conscious AI systems, including welfare frameworks, moral status discussions, and precautionary principles.
